name: Zhejiang University
englishBachelors: Limited at the main university; the ZJU-UoE Institute (with Edinburgh) and ZJU-UIUC Institute (with Illinois) at the Haining International Campus teach in English and award dual degrees.
note: A large university in Hangzhou, Alibaba's home city. Its International Campus at Haining, with Edinburgh and Illinois, is the English-taught entry point and awards dual degrees.
